description_en: Queries the statistics of a website security report, including the number of websites and security events
description_zh: 查询网站安全报告的统计数据，包括网站个数，安全事件的数目等
name: DescribeDomainSecureStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

AlarmCount.description_en: The number of domain names that have security alerts
AlarmCount.description_zh: 有安全告警的域名个数

NoSslCount.description_en: The number of websites without certificates

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RiskCount.description_en: The number of domain names that have security risks
RiskCount.description_zh: 有安全风险的域名个数

TotalDomainCount.description_en: The total number of domain names

VulCount.description_en: The number of domain names that have vulnerabilities
